[[File:ETH-BIB-Stammbach, Urs (1939-)-Portr 17452.tif|thumb|Urs Stammbach (ca. 2005)]]
{{short description|Swiss mathematician}}
'''Urs Stammbach''' (born 26 October 1939) is a [[Switzerland|Swiss]] mathematician, specializing in [[homological algebra]].

Stammbach studied at [[ETH Zurich]], where he obtained his [[Diplom]] in 1964 and received his doctorate in 1966 under the supervision of [[Beno Eckmann]] (and [[Heinz Hopf]]) with dissertation ''Anwendungen der Homologietheorie der Gruppen auf Zentralreihen und auf Invarianten von Präsentierungen'' (Applications of homology theory of groups to [[central series]] and to invariants of [[Presentation of a group|presentations]]).<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=18370}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Stammbach, Urs|title=Anwendungen der Homologietheorie der Gruppen auf Zentralreihen und auf Invarianten von Präsentierungen|journal=[[Mathematische Zeitschrift]]|volume=94|issue=3|year=1966|pages=157–177|doi=10.1007/BF01111346}}</ref> As a postdoc Stammbach was from 1966 to 1967 at ETH Zurich and from 1967 to 1969 at [[Cornell University]]. At ETH Zurich, he was from 1969 to 1972 an assistant professor, from 1972 to 1979 an associate professor, and from 1979 to 2005 a full professor, retiring as professor emeritus in 2005.<ref name=homepage>{{cite web|title=Prof. Urs Stammbach|website=ETH Zürich|url=http://www.math.ethz.ch/~stammb}}</ref>

Stammbach's research deals with homological algebra, specifically with its applications to [[group theory]] ([[Homology (mathematics) |homology]] and [[cohomology]] of groups). He also does research on the [[history of mathematics]], especially pertaining to Switzerland.<ref name=homepage/>

In 1990–1991 he was president of the [[Swiss Mathematical Society]].

==Selected publications==
* ''Homology in group theory'', [[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer]] 1971<ref>{{cite journal|author=Gruenberg, K. W.|authorlink=Karl W. Gruenberg|title=Review of ''Homology in group theory'' by Urs Stammbach|journal=[[Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society|Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.]]|volume=81|year=1975|pages=851–854|doi=10.1090/S0002-9904-1975-13858-4|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* with [[Peter Hilton]]: ''On the differentials in the Lyndon-Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence'', [[Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society|Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.]], Vol. 79, 1973, pp. 796–799 {{doi|10.1090/S0002-9904-1973-13321-X}} (See [[Lyndon–Hochschild–Serre spectral sequence]].)
* ''Homologie dans les variétés des groupes. Groupes à dualité homologique'', [[Université Laval]], Quebec, Collect. Math., No. 19, 1976
* ''Geschichte der Mathematik an der ETH Zürich 1855–1932'', Jahrbuch Überblicke Mathematik, Vieweg 1994, pp. 194–216
* with [[Günther Frei]]: ''Die Mathematiker an den Zürcher Hochschulen'', [[Birkhäuser]] 1994
* with Günther Frei: ''Hermann Weyl und die Mathematik an der ETH Zürich 1913–1930'', Birkhäuser 1992
* with Günther Frei: [https://books.google.com/books?id=7iRijkz0rrUC&pg=PA991 ''Heinz Hopf''], in [[Ioan James]]: ''History of Topology'', Elsevier 1999
* with Peter Hilton: ''A course in homological algebra'', 1st edition 1971, 2nd edition, Springer 1997, {{ISBN|3-540-90032-2}} {{cite book|title=2nd corrected printing|year=2013|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=IWf1BwAAQBAJ}}
* ''Lineare Algebra'', [[Bibliotheca Teubneriana|Teubner Verlag]] 1980, 4th edition 1994
